# etag_conditional_middle — conditional middle step in a 3-step chain.
# state.etag_check defaults to true so the middle step runs and returns
# {"next_path": "/etag_conditional_middle/events"}. The final step's
# select.branches arm picks steps.middle.body.next_path (present) and
# fetches /etag_conditional_middle/events for the event payload. Only the
# final step is marked produces_events: true — middle body is consulted
# for the path only.

replace spec.yml /api/v1/etag/probe /etag_conditional_middle/probe
replace spec.yml /api/v1/etag/data /etag_conditional_middle/data
replace spec.yml /api/v1/etag/fallback /etag_conditional_middle/fallback
replace spec.yml http://localhost:9999 $URL
exec skopos run -i spec.yml --once --trace trace.jsonl --out events.jsonl
normalize trace.jsonl
cmp trace.jsonl want_trace.jsonl
cmp events.jsonl want_events.jsonl

-- spec.yml --
ir_version: "1"

state:
  fields:
    url:
      type: url
      default: "http://localhost:9999"
    etag_check:
      type: bool
      default: true

defaults:
  base_url: {ref: state.url}

auth:
  none: {}

requests:
  - id: probe
    method: GET
    path: /api/v1/etag/probe

  - id: middle
    method: GET
    path: /api/v1/etag/data
    if:
      eq:
        path: state.etag_check
        equal: true
    on_status:
      304: skip

  - id: events
    method: GET
    path:
      select:
        branches:
          - when:
              present: steps.middle.body.next_path
            value:
              ref: steps.middle.body.next_path
        default: /api/v1/etag/fallback
    produces_events: true

response:
  decode: json
  events_at: items

pagination:
  none: {}

progress:
  stateless: {}

error:
  mode: standard
-- want_trace.jsonl --

{"elapsed":"<scrubbed>","iteration":1,"method":"GET","request_headers":{"Accept":"application/json, application/x-ndjson;q=0.9, */*;q=0.1"},"response_body":"body 48 bytes, object-like","started_at":"<scrubbed>","status":200,"step_id":"middle","url":"$URL_HOST/etag_conditional_middle/data"}
{"elapsed":"<scrubbed>","iteration":1,"method":"GET","request_headers":{"Accept":"application/json, application/x-ndjson;q=0.9, */*;q=0.1"},"response_body":"body 347 bytes, object-like","started_at":"<scrubbed>","status":200,"step_id":"events","url":"$URL_HOST/etag_conditional_middle/events"}
